# CBDB-Desktop: Query By Example (QBE) translation, 2026-10-28

Revised later the same day: the Sort options are now translated. The Query Builder page (qbe.html) was English only. It now has the same language switch as the forms reviewed against FormLabels (EN / 繁 / 简, with a Display Language label), and every label, hint, tooltip and message has traditional and simplified Chinese. QBE has no FormLabels rows, so all the wording is new. Traditional Chinese uses Taiwan's software terms and simplified Chinese mainland terms, following the regional-usage rule of 2026-10-27; terms from SQL stay in English (see below). Changes are in qbe.html only. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was driven in a scripted browser (jsdom) against a mock server: two tables, a two-field join, three Select List rows with grouping, a query run, the join dialog open, then a switch to each language, with every visible string and tooltip checked. No script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app.** A copy of the page before these changes was kept as qbe.before-i18n.html.

## How it works

- **Labels.** All wording is in one object, T, near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified (78 keys in each). To change a translation, change its value there. The full list is at the end of this report.
- **Static text** in the page carries a data-i18n attribute (text), data-i18n-html (the sidebar notes, which contain &lt;code&gt; and &lt;em&gt;) or data-i18n-title (tooltips). setLanguage() fills them in. The English remains in the markup as well.
- **Script-built text** (the table list, the canvas boxes' tooltips, join lines, the join dialog, the Select List, Results-column tooltips, the SQL placeholder and all messages) calls i18n(key, params). setLanguage() redraws each of these, so switching language mid-query changes everything already on screen, including an open join dialog and the current status message.
- **Messages** set with setStatusT() / setBarT() are remembered and re-shown in the new language. Error messages built in the page (for example, tables not joined) are re-translated too. Error messages that come **from the server** are shown as the server sends them, in English.
- **Title bar.** It now matches the other forms: "CBDB: " + form name, Display Language, EN / 繁 / 简, and a translated "← Navigation" link (was "← Home"). The page title is "CBDB: Query By Example" / 範例查詢 (Taiwan; Access calls this 依範例查詢) / 示例查询 (mainland).
- **Default language** on opening is English, as on the other forms.

## What stays in English, and why

These are SQL words, or values the user types or sees in the SQL, so translating them would separate the interface from the query it builds:

| Item | Shown as | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Group drop-down | (none), Group by, Count, Max, Min, Ave, Sum | SQL GROUP BY and aggregate functions (user's decision). The column heading is translated: 群組 / 分组. |
| Join types | Inner, Left; line label INNER JOIN / LEFT JOIN | SQL join kinds. The field count on the line is translated, e.g. INNER JOIN（2 組欄位）. |
| Distinct | Distinct | SQL SELECT DISTINCT. Its tooltip is translated (相同的資料列只傳回一次). |
| Criteria syntax | &gt;100, Like "%Fujian%", Between 1000 And 1100, In (1, 2, 3), And, Or | What the user types into Criteria. The explanatory sentence under the examples is translated. |
| Sidebar notes | (none), Group by, WHERE, HAVING, Count, Or | Named exactly as they appear in the drop-downs or the SQL. |
| Badges and values | VIEW, NULL, SQL, table and field names (BIOG_MAIN, c_name_chn), table aliases (t1, t2) | Database names and values. |

**Sort options are translated** (user, 2026-10-28): Asc / Desc are 遞增 / 遞減 in traditional and 升序 / 降序 in simplified. Unlike the Group options, they are never typed or shown in the SQL as words; the values sent to the server are still ASC / DESC.

## Terminology

The main terms, in the conventions of each region's database software (Access, SQL Server Management Studio):

| English | Traditional (Taiwan) | Simplified (mainland) |
|---|---|---|
| Query By Example | 範例查詢 | 示例查询 |
| table | 資料表 | 表 |
| field | 欄位 | 字段 |
| join | 聯結 | 联接 |
| self-join | 自我聯結 | 自联接 |
| canvas / workspace | 工作區 | 工作区 |
| Select List | 選取清單 | 选择列表 |
| Criteria | 準則 | 条件 |
| Group (heading) | 群組 | 分组 |
| aggregate | 彙總函數 | 聚合函数 |
| row (of results) | 資料列; 筆 (counting) | 行; 条记录 (counting) |
| double-click | 按兩下 | 双击 |
| click / Shift-click | 按一下 / 按住 Shift 再點選 | 单击 / 按住 Shift 键单击 |
| drag | 拖曳 | 拖动 |
| header (of a table box) | 標題列 | 标题栏 |
| export | 匯出 | 导出 |
| save (a file) | 儲存 | 保存 |
| clipboard | 剪貼簿 | 剪贴板 |
| tab-delimited file | 定位字元分隔檔 | 制表符分隔文件 |
| Run Query | 查詢 | 查询 |
| Sort: ascending / descending | 遞增 / 遞減 | 升序 / 降序 |

Run Query, Export Query Results and Navigation use the same wording as on the other forms. Note that "row" and "column" differ between the regions (Taiwan 列 = row, 欄 = column; mainland 行 = row, 列 = column); the translations follow each region's usage.

## Small changes made along the way

- The Results tab's label is now in its own &lt;span&gt;, so translating it doesn't remove the row-count badge.
- The join diamond's tooltip is now set every time the line is drawn, not only when the join is created, so it follows the language.
- The join dialog's title and OK button are set by a new refreshJoinModalText(), used both when it opens and on a language switch.
- The function is called i18n() rather than tr(), because the Select List and join-dialog code already use tr for table rows.

## Issues

1. **Server error messages** (data.message from /api/qbe/run, e.g. a criteria syntax error) are English only. Translating them would need message codes from the back end.
1. **Schema labels.** Table and field names in the table list and the boxes come from /api/qbe/schema (label or name) and are not translated. If the schema ever gets Chinese labels, the page would need a field for them.
1. **Results column names** (e.g. BiogMain.c_name_chn, CountOfKinDataKinId) are built from table labels and field names and stay as they are; they are also the column names in the exported file.

## Still to check in the running app

- The title bar (title, Display Language, three buttons and Navigation on one line) and the narrow left panel's hint in each language.
- The Select List column widths with 欄位 / 字段 etc. (fixed widths of 190, 50, 80 and 90px).
- Switching language with a join dialog open and with results on screen.
- That the sidebar notes read well; they are the longest translated texts.
